blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adapting a single vision-language model to medical image parsing requires training choices that reflect the demands of each task. We study task-specific adaptation with Qwen3.5-9B for FLARE 2026 Task 3, covering six task families and seven imaging modalities. Our system couples a shared, frozen 4-bit backbone with LoRA adapters selected from the input question. We customize adapter ranks and prompts, rebalance rare classification targets, and supplement regression training with dermatology classification examples. On the fixed internal holdout, the task-specific adapters achieve a dataset-macro balanced accuracy of 0.7791 for classification, a dataset-macro micro-F1 of 0.6286 for multi-label classification, a counting mean absolute error (MAE) of 11.73, a dataset-macro detection F1 of 0.8914, a dataset-macro regression MAE of 9.78, and a report-generation CRIMSON score of 0.8204. On the organizer's 1,703-example hidden-validation set, the submitted system achieves 0.8496 classification balanced accuracy, 0.5338 sample-averaged multi-label F1, and 14.5950 regression MAE. The final 30.1 GB container averages 3.1 seconds per case, including model loading, and produces identical outputs across repeated verification runs. The benefits vary across tasks, supporting the use of task-specific adapter configurations and image budgets within a shared medical vision-language model. Code is available at https://github.com/TahaSabir0/FLARE26-Hexapus.
blocks.zh: 使单一的视觉语言模型适应医疗图像剖析需要能够反映每项任务要求的培训选择。 我们用Qwen3.5-9B为FLARE 2026任务3研究特定任务适应,涵盖6个任务家庭和7个成像模式. 我们的系统与LORA适配器 共享,冷冻的4位骨干结合 从输入问题。 我们定制适配器的等级和提示,重新平衡稀有分类目标,并以皮肤学分类实例补充回归训练. 在固定的内部搁置上,任务特定的适配器实现数据集-宏观平衡精度0.7791的分类,数据集-宏观微F1的多标签分类为0.6286,计数平均绝对误差(MAE)为11.73,数据集-宏观检测F1为0.8914,数据集-宏观回归MAE为9.78,报告生成的CRIMSON得分为0.8204. 在组织器的1,703-实例的隐藏-验证集上,提交系统实现了0.8496分类平衡精度,0.5338样本平均多标签F1和14.595回归MAE. 最终的30.1GB集装箱平均每箱3.1秒,包括模型装载,并在多次核查中产生相同的产出。 这些好处因任务而异,支持在共同的医疗视觉语言模式下使用特定任务适配器配置和图像预算. 代码见https://github.com/TahaSabir0/FLARE26-Hexapus。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Unlike conventional visual question answering (VQA), where the expected response is primarily textual, medical image parsing requires a general medical vision-language model (VLM) to interpret heterogeneous visual inputs and produce task-appropriate outputs ranging from categorical and multi-label predictions to numerical estimates, bounding boxes, and free-form reports, across modalities with different visual characteristics and anatomical morphologies. Medical VLMs range from biomedical dialogue systems such as LLaVA-Med [ 10 ] to models pretrained across clinical imaging domains such as MedGemma [ 16 ] , and benchmarks compare generalist and specialist performance across clinical domains [ 24 ] . Med-MoE [ 9 ] illustrates the need to combine discriminative and generative medical tasks, while a systematic task-transfer study [ 15 ] shows that fine-tuning one visual capability can unpredictably improve or degrade others.
blocks.zh: 与常规视觉问题回答(VQA)不同的是,预期的答案主要是文字上的,医学图像解析需要一种一般的医学视觉语言模型(VLM)来解释各种视觉输入,并产生从绝对的和多标签的预测到数字估计,边框,以及自由形式的报告,跨不同视觉特征的模式和解剖形态. 医疗VLM从LLaVA-Med等生物医学对话系统到MedGemma等临床成像领域预先培训的模型[16],基准比较临床领域的通论和专家表现[24]. Med-MoE[9]说明有必要将歧视性和遗传性医疗任务结合起来,而系统的任务转移研究[15]表明,微调一种视觉能力无法预测地改善或降低其他任务。

blocks.en: FLARE 2026 Task 3 [ 6 ] provides a practical setting for studying this problem. After data cleaning, its 51,154 question-answer pairs and 50,996 images span 19 datasets, eight imaging modalities, and seven task types; excluding unscored instance detection and endoscopy, our evaluation covers 17 datasets, seven modalities, and six scored task families: classification, multi-label classification, counting, detection, regression, and report generation. A single shared adaptation may suffer from interference between these tasks, whereas a separate fine-tuned VLM per task would substantially increase training, storage, and deployment costs.
blocks.zh: FLARE 2026 第3 [6]号任务为研究这个问题提供了一个实用的环境. 在数据清理之后,它的51,154个问答对和50,996个图像跨越了19个数据集、8个成像模式和7个任务类型;不包括无分数实例检测和内分镜,我们的评价涵盖17个数据集、7个模式和6个得分任务类别:分类、多标签分类、计数、检测、回归和报告生成。 一项单一的共同适应可能因这些任务之间的干扰而受到影响,而一项单独的微调VLM将大大增加培训、储存和部署费用。

blocks.en: Related Work. General-domain VLMs such as BLIP-2 [ 11 ] and Qwen2.5-VL [ 2 ] align visual and language representations through lightweight bridging modules or dynamic-resolution processing, while medical systems including LLaVA-Med [ 10 ] , HuatuoGPT-Vision [ 4 ] , and MedGemma [ 16 ] add medical image–text training or domain-specific visual representations. Yet parsing outputs differ in visual evidence, supervision, and decoding constraints. Previous challenge solutions to FLARE 2025 Task 5 [ 12 ] use different forms of specialization: QwenVLConnector [ 13 ] fuses multi-level visual features, ME-VLIP [ 17 ] routes questions among task-specific QLoRA adapters and a multi-task fallback, and Sun et al. [ 19 ] use a medically pretrained vision encoder with a shared LoRA-adapted language model. These approaches show that broad task coverage is possible but leave open how task-specific adaptation, prompting, and visual resolution should be allocated within one shared, deployable backbone. LoRA [ 8 ] , QLoRA [ 5 ] , and LLaMA-Factory [ 23 ] make such modular specialization practical.
blocks.zh: 相關工作. 普通-域相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 然而,分析产出在视觉证据、监督和解码限制方面各不相同。 FLARE 2025以往的挑战解决方案 任务5 [12] 使用不同形式的专业化: QuenVLConnector [13] 将多层次的视觉特性、ME-VLIP [17] 任务特定的QLORA适配器和多任务倒置之间的路线问题,以及Sun等人。 [19]使用医学预训视觉编码器,并使用共同的LORA适应语言模型. 这些办法表明,任务范围很广是可能的,但对于如何在一个共同的、可部署的骨干中分配针对具体任务的适应、促进和可视化的解决,却留有余地。 LoRA [8],QLORA [5],以及LLaMA-Factory [23] 使这种模块化的专业化成为实用.

blocks.en: Contributions. Our system uses Qwen3.5-9B [ 14 ] with a question-only GLiClass router [ 18 ] (DeBERTa-V3 [ 7 ] ) selecting one of six specialist adapters or a general fallback on one shared 4-bit backbone. Our contributions are: • We develop and validate a parameter-efficient system for six medical image-parsing tasks using one quantized Qwen3.5-9B backbone and lightweight task-specific LoRA adapters. • We compare the adapted system with its zero-shot Qwen3.5-9B backbone on an internal holdout and public validation data. • We compare specialist and general adapters, measure task-dependent resolution effects, and analyze errors hidden by aggregate metrics.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 我们的系统使用Qwen3.5-9B [14],只使用一个问题GLIClass路由器 [18] (DEBERTa-V3 [7])在六个专业适配器中选择一个,或者在一个共享的4位主干上选择一个一般倒置. • 我们的贡献是: 我们利用一个被量化的Quen3.5-9B主干线和轻量级任务特定的LORA适配器,为6个医疗图像解析任务开发并验证一个参数效率系统。 我们把经过改造的系统与其在内部阻塞和公众验证数据上的零射出Quen3.5-9B主干网进行比较。 我们比较专家和一般适配器,衡量任务依赖的解析效果,并分析汇总度量法所隐藏的错误.

blocks.en: We develop and validate a parameter-efficient system for six medical image-parsing tasks using one quantized Qwen3.5-9B backbone and lightweight task-specific LoRA adapters.

blocks.zh: 我们比较了经过改造的系统 与它的零射出Qwen3.5-9B主干网 在内部阻断 和公众验证数据。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: We use one quantized Qwen3.5-9B backbone with task-specific LoRA adapters. A question-only router selects the adapter, image budget, and prompt for each case (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用一个量化的 Quen3.5-9B 骨干 和任务特定的 LoRA 适配器。 一个只提问的路由器会选择适配器,图像预算,并针对每个大小写(图1.

blocks.en: 2.1 Data preparation and image handling
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据准备和图像处理

blocks.en: We audited the official FLARE 2026 Task 3 2D data [ 6 ] and excluded 73 records that failed task-specific validity checks: 47 endoscopy records with invalid labels, 17 BUSI detection records with inverted or zero-area boxes, seven periapical records with contradictory labels, one duplicated periapical record, and one Boneresorption record with an extreme target value of 2,085 (dataset median: 28). We also excluded all 1,248 instance-detection samples because this task was not scored, and omitted endoscopy from adapter training because of its few usable examples, long multi-frame inputs, and noisy labels.
blocks.zh: 我们审计了正式的FLARE 2026任务3 二D数据[6],并排除了73个失败任务特定有效性检查的记录:47个内镜记录有无效标签,17个BUSI检测记录有倒数或零面积框,7个周边记录有自相矛盾的标签,1个重复的周边记录,以及1个Bonerecopy记录,极端目标值为2,085(数据集中值:28). 我们还排除了所有1,248个实例检测样本,因为这项工作没有打入分数,并省略了适配器训练中的内镜检查,因为其可用实例很少,多帧输入长,标签也吵闹.

blocks.en: Following ME-VLIP [ 17 ] , we expanded each multi-image training example into separate single-image examples, repeating the question and answer for each image. Questions sharing an image remained in the same partition. In earlier Qwen3-VL-8B experiments, grouping three neojaundice images reduced balanced accuracy in two complementary train–validation folds; this motivated, but does not validate, the policy for Qwen3.5-9B. At inference, the system accepts up to four images and selects four evenly spaced images from longer sequences.
blocks.zh: 继ME-VLIP [17]后,我们将每个多图像训练实例扩展为单独的单图像实例,重复每个图像的问答. 分享图像的问题仍然在同一分区内。 在更早的Quen3-VL-8B实验中,将3个新jaundice图像分组,降低了两个互补列车的平衡精度-验证折叠;这有动机但不能验证对Quen3.5-9B的政策. 推论,系统接受最多4个图像,并从较长的序列中选择4个均匀相距的图像.

blocks.en: Image preprocessing consists of RGB conversion and aspect-ratio-preserving resizing when an image exceeds its route’s pixel-area cap. The cap is a maximum area, not a forced square shape. We used no additional image transformations, unlabeled examples, or partial labels.
blocks.zh: 图像预处理包括RGB转换和当图像超过其路由像素-区域封顶时的方格-ratio-保留再大小. 盖子为最大面积,不是强迫平方形. 我们没有使用额外的图像转换, 没有标签的例子, 或部分标签。

blocks.en: 2.2 Shared backbone and task routing
blocks.zh: 2.2 共享骨干和任务路线

blocks.en: All routes use one Qwen3.5-9B backbone loaded with 4-bit NF4 quantization and bfloat16 computation. The pretrained backbone remains frozen. Six task-specific LoRA adapters and one general adapter, trained across all scored tasks, are loaded into the same model; switching tasks changes the active adapter without reloading the backbone.
blocks.zh: 所有路线都使用一个装有4位NF4分数和bfloat16计算器的Quen3.5-9B主干线. 训练有素的骨干仍被冻结 6个任务特定的LORA适配器和1个通用适配器,经过所有得分任务的培训,被装入同一种模型;切换任务改变活性适配器而无需再装入主干.

blocks.en: We reuse the GLiClass classifier released with ME-VLIP [ 17 ] , without further training. It uses a DeBERTa-v3-small encoder to predict a task label and confidence from the question text alone. The corresponding specialist is activated when the top confidence is at least 0.3 and the label has a configured route; otherwise, the general adapter is used. Supplied TaskType and Modality metadata do not influence routing.
blocks.zh: 我们重新使用与ME-VLIP一起发布的GLIClass分类器[17],无需再接受进一步训练. 它使用一个DEBERTa-v3-小编码器来预测任务标签和仅从问题文本中产生的信心. 当顶部置信度至少为0.3而标签有被配置的路由时,相应的专家被激活;否则,使用一般适配器. 被应用的TaskType和Modity元数据不会影响路由.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Routed inference with a shared quantized backbone. The question selects a specialist or the general fallback, together with the image budget and prompt used for answer generation.
blocks.zh: 图1:采用共用的量化主干线的路由推论。 问题选择专家或一般倒置,连同图像预算和用于生成答案的提示.

blocks.en: 2.3 Task-specific adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.3 针对具体任务的适应

blocks.en: We train each adapter by supervised fine-tuning, optimizing LoRA parameters with loss applied only to the answer tokens. Table 1 lists the deployed configurations. In the table, the full labeled pool comprises A ∪ B A\cup B , the internal holdout, and validation-public ; prompt variants are defined in Section 2.4 . Shared optimization settings are given in Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过有监督的微调来训练每个适配器,优化了LORA参数,损失只适用于答号. 表1列出了已部署的配置。 在表格中,被贴上标签的完整池包括A QQ B A\cup B、内部阻塞和验证-公用;第2.4节定义了即时变体。 第3.2节提供了共享优化设置。

blocks.en: Table 1: Per-route configuration of the proposed system. Pixel values denote maximum image-area budgets, not forced square resizing.
blocks.zh: 表1:拟议系统的每个路线配置。 像素值表示最大映像区预算,而不是强迫正方形再大小.

blocks.en: Preliminary Qwen3-VL-8B experiments informed the LoRA [ 8 ] ranks retained for Qwen3.5-9B: 32 for classification, 64 for multi-label classification, and 8 for the remaining adapters, with α = 2 ​ r \alpha=2r throughout.
blocks.zh: 初步的Qwen3-VL-8B实验告知了为Quen3.5-9B保留的LORA[8]级:分类为32名,多标签分类为64名,其余适配器为8名,全长为α = 2 r\ alpha=2r.

blocks.en: For classification, we use capped oversampling of rare dataset–answer groups. A group containing n < 250 n<250 training examples is expanded by duplication to min ⁡ ( 6 ​ n , 250 ) \min(6n,250) examples; larger groups are unchanged. For regression, we combine 5,265 examples from A ∪ B A\cup B with 5,000 bcn20000 dermatology-classification examples. The A / B A/B partitions and internal holdout are defined in Section 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 对于分类,我们使用对稀有数据集-答案组的超标抽样。 包含n < 250 n < 250培训实例的一组通过重复被扩展为min QQ(6 n, 250)\min(6n, 250)实例;较大组不变. 关于回归,我们把来自A QQ B A\cup B的5 265个例子和5,000 bcn20000 皮肤学-分类学的例子结合起来。 A / B A / B 分区和内部阻隔在第3.1节中界定。

blocks.en: Adapters trained on A ∪ B A\cup B provide the internal comparisons. For deployment, classification, multi-label classification, counting, and detection were subsequently refitted on the full labeled development pool. Regression, report generation, and the general fallback retain their A ∪ B A\cup B adapters.
blocks.zh: 接受过AQQB A\cup B培训的适配器提供内部比较. 对于部署,分类,多标签分类,计分,检测,随后在全标签的开发池上重新进行. 后退 报告生成 和一般后退 保留他们的 A QQ B A\cup B适配器.

blocks.en: 2.4 Prompting and inference
blocks.zh: 2.4 提示和推论

blocks.en: Each user message contains indexed image markers followed by the original question. Counting and multi-label classification also use the instructions below, placed before the question. They are inspired by chain-of-thought prompting [ 21 ] , but training supervises only final answers. The remaining routes use the bare image–question prompt.
blocks.zh: 每个用户消息包含索引的图像标记,然后是原始问题. 计数和多标签分类也使用下面的说明,放在问题之前. 他们受到思维链的启发[21],但培训只监督最后答案。 其余路线使用赤裸的图像 – 有疑问的提示 。

blocks.en: Task-specific prompts Counting System You are a medical image analysis expert. Think carefully before answering. Task instruction Methodically count each object in the image (scan left-to-right, row by row). Write the final count as a single integer. Multi-label classification System You are an expert radiologist and medical image analyst specialising in X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, pathology, endoscopy, and microscopy. Think carefully and systematically before answering. Task instruction For each listed finding, assess whether it is clearly visible in the image. List only confirmed findings separated by commas.
blocks.zh: 特定任务的提示 计数系统 你是医学影像分析专家 答前仔细想. 任务指令 用方法计算图像中的每个对象(扫描从左到右,逐行排列). 将最终数写为单个整数. 多标签分类系统 你是放射学专家 医学影像分析师 专门研究X光、CT、核磁共振、超声波、病理学、内分镜和显微镜 在回答之前仔细和系统地思考。 任务指令 对于每个列出的发现,评估在图像中是否明显可见. 仅列出以逗号分隔的确认结论.

blocks.en: Generation uses greedy decoding ( do_sample=False ), at most 512 new tokens, fixed end-of-sequence and padding identifiers, and Qwen3.5 thinking mode disabled. Post-processing removes any thinking tags, retains the final line for classification, normalizes multi-label delimiters, extracts detection boxes and numeric answers, and retains report text. If no numeric value is found, the numeric parser returns zero. We apply no calibration, re-querying, or manual answer correction.
blocks.zh: 世代使用贪婪的解码(do_sample=False),最多512个新代号,固定的末端和地标标识符,而Quen3.5思维模式被禁用. 后处理会去掉任何思维标记,保留分类的最后一行,使多标签的分隔符正常化,取出检测框和数字答案,并保留报告文本. 如果找不到数值,则数值解析器返回为零。 我们没有进行校正、重新征服或手动校正。

blocks.en: The container packages the backbone, adapters, tokenizer, and router for fully offline execution. Its runtime, size, and repeated-run checks are reported in Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 集装箱将主干、适配器、活化器和路由器装入完全离线执行。 第4.4节报告了其运行时间、规模和重复运行的检查。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset and evaluation measures
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和评价措施

blocks.en: Dataset. The cleaned source pool for FLARE 2026 Task 3 [ 6 ] contained 51,154 question–answer pairs from the organizer training and public-validation data. After the exclusions described in Section 2.1 , our evaluation covers 17 datasets, seven imaging modalities, and six scored task families.
blocks.zh: 数据集. FLARE 2026任务3[6]的清理源池包含来自组织者培训和公共验证数据的51,154个问答对. 在第2.1节所述排除情况之后,我们的评估涵盖17个数据集、7个成像模式和6个得分任务家庭。

blocks.en: Following recommended cross-validation practice for medical-imaging AI [ 3 ] , we partitioned the organizer training data by image group, stratified by dataset and task combination, into an approximately 10% internal holdout and two 45% subsets, A A and B B (Fig. 2 ). Smaller subsets A ′ ⊂ A A^{\prime}\subset A and B ′ ⊂ B B^{\prime}\subset B , each containing 30% of its parent partition, supported inexpensive preliminary screening before selected configurations were evaluated on the full A / B A/B partitions. Full A → B A\rightarrow B and B → A B\rightarrow A experiments were run where available. These partitions were fixed before expanding multi-image examples into single-image training rows.
blocks.zh: 根据对医疗成像AI[3]的建议交叉验证做法,我们将组织者培训数据按图像组进行分解,通过数据集和任务组合进行分级,分为大约10%的内部坚持和45%的子集A和B(图2)。 较小的子集A ' A ' A ' primeme ' subset A和B ' B ' B ' prime ' subset B,每个子集包含其母分区的30%,支持在对A/B A/B完整分区进行选定配置评价之前进行廉价的初步筛选。 完全 A ~ B 右转 B和B —— 一个右手 已进行实验。 这些分区在将多图像实例扩展为单图像训练行之前被固定.

blocks.en: Adapted models in the internal and public-validation comparisons are trained on A ∪ B A\cup B ; public-validation images overlapping the organizer training data were excluded. Although internal-holdout images were excluded from these adapters’ training, holdout results informed some development choices. We therefore treat the holdout results as development comparisons rather than independent estimates of generalization [ 20 ] . Selected deployment routes were later refitted with the holdout and public-validation data (Table 1 ); scores on these previously seen cases are not reported as held-out performance.

blocks.en: We evaluate the internal and public splits separately, computing each metric per dataset and reporting its unweighted mean within each task. Counting and report generation each contain one evaluated dataset. Excluding endoscopy, internal/public classification covers ten/six datasets, multi-label classification two/one, and detection three/two. Regression has two internal datasets and no public cases. Organizer hidden-validation scores (Section 4.1 ) instead pool cases within each task. Differences in dataset composition and aggregation prevent direct comparison with our dataset-macro results.
blocks.zh: 我们分别评估内部和公开的划分,计算每个数据集的每个度量,并在每项任务中报告其未加权的平均值。 计算和报告生成均包含一个经过评价的数据集。 除内镜外,内部/公共分类包括10个/6个数据集、多标签分类2/1和检测3/2。 后退有两个内部数据集,没有公案. 组织者隐藏-验证分数(第4.1节)取而代之的是将案件集中到每项任务中。 数据集组成和汇总方面的差异阻碍了与我们的数据集-宏观结果的直接比较。

blocks.en: Statistical uncertainty. Paired 95% confidence intervals in the configuration ablations use 10,000 bootstrap resamples of matched question–answer cases, sampled with replacement within each dataset using the same sampled indices for both configurations. For the general-versus-specialist regression comparison, interval bounds are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the resampled MAE differences. This case-level resampling treats question–answer cases as independent; the intervals do not account for dependence between questions sharing an image or variation across training seeds.
blocks.zh: 统计不确定性。 Paired 95%的配置置信间隔使用10,000个匹配的问答案例的靴子套装,在每个数据集内用相同的两个配置的样本索引进行取出取回。 就一般与专门回归比较而言,间隔界限是重印的MAE差异的2.5和97.5百分位数。 这种案例级复标将问答案例视为独立案例;间隔并不说明共享图像的问题之间的依赖性或培训种子之间的差异。

blocks.en: Comparison protocols. We compare A ∪ B A\cup B adapters with two zero-shot baselines on the same splits. The first uses the deployed prompts, answer prefixes, extraction rules, and 512-token limit. The format-assisted baseline adds explicit output-format instructions, removes the answer prefix, changes answer extraction, and allows 1,024 tokens. Both retain the same 4-bit Qwen3.5-9B backbone, greedy decoding, disabled thinking mode, and task-specific image budgets ( 768 2 768^{2} for reports, 2048 2 2048^{2} otherwise). Thus, their difference measures a combined inference-protocol change, not a prompt-only effect. These evaluations select configurations using known task assignments and do not measure router accuracy or end-to-end container performance. Report generation uses only the first baseline; comparisons retain reports scored successfully for both models (780 internal and 1,943 public cases).
blocks.zh: 比较协议. 我们比较A QQ B A\cup B适配器和两个同分的零射入基线. 第一种是使用所部署的提示,回答前缀,取出规则,以及512个托肯限制. 格式辅助基线增加了明确的输出格式指令,去掉了答案前缀,更改了答案提取,并允许出1,024个令牌. 两者都保留了相同的4位Qwen3.5-9B主干线,贪婪的解码,残疾思维模式,以及任务特定图像预算(768 2 768^{2}为报告,2048 2. 2048^{2}否则). 因此,它们的区别衡量的是综合推论-议定书的变化,而不是一种迅速的效果。 这些评价利用已知的任务任务选择配置,不衡量路由器准确性或端到端容器性能. 报告生成只使用第一个基线;比较保留了两个模型(780个内部案例和1 943个公开案例)的得分。

blocks.en: 4.6 Limitations and future work
blocks.zh: 4.6 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
The organizer hidden-validation score covers classification, multi-label
classification, and regression only. The announced final-testing results additionally
reports detection F1, but no counting or report-generation scores. Evidence for
these two tasks is therefore limited to the internal and public-validation sets,
which differ in composition and are not directly comparable. Our Qwen3.5-9B
experiments also use a single training seed. The 2048 2 2048^{2} production-adapter
runs peaked at approximately 40–44 GB of GPU memory, requiring a 48 GB-class or
larger GPU, whereas the lower-resolution runs fit on our 24 GB workstation GPUs;
the resolution comparisons also differed in GPU class and micro-batch
shape at the same effective batch size. Future work should confirm these
task-dependent effects across seeds, quantify errors introduced by the
question-only router, and investigate selective high-resolution processing or
adaptive tiling under matched compute budgets. A promising extension would combine our adapter routing with the multi-level visual feature
fusion of QwenVLConnector [ 13 ] , letting the router also select a specialized visual pathway for fine spatial detail.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We demonstrate that a single quantized VLM can support six heterogeneous medical
image-parsing tasks without a separate backbone for each one. The submitted
30.1 GB system averaged 3.1 seconds per case and achieved an overall score of
0.4825 on organizer hidden validation across classification, multi-label
classification, and regression. Our controlled comparisons show no universal adaptation recipe: specialist adapters improved selected structured
tasks, higher resolution substantially benefited dense counting but produced
smaller or inconsistent gains elsewhere, and the general adapter remained
competitive for some routes. Report generation exposed a different limitation:
structurally valid outputs could still omit clinically relevant findings, with
61.4% of abnormal-reference cases receiving normal-only predictions. A shared backbone should therefore unify deployment, not force uniform training
or inference; future generalist medical VLMs should allocate adapter capacity and
visual detail by task demand and be evaluated per dataset and failure mode, not aggregate scores.
